categories.main_business_segments: The company operates three main business segments: Trade Business Group focusing on export of household goods and garments; Fashion and Luxury Goods Group handling retail and wholesale of apparel and accessories including high-end brands; and Biotechnology and Investment Group engaged in medical devices, dialysis products, and green energy businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: As a trading and retail company, it does not engage in manufacturing but emphasizes product development in trade by sourcing new styles, materials, and functions globally. It also invests in biotechnology and green energy sectors, leveraging medical device approvals and energy storage technologies. The company employs digital marketing, e-commerce platforms, and supply chain automation such as AGV and RFID for logistics efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include large importers and distributors in the US, Canada, Mexico, and other emerging markets for export products; domestic consumers for fashion retail brands including G2000 and luxury brands; and hospitals, clinics, and healthcare providers for medical devices and dialysis products. The company also targets end consumers through retail stores and e-commerce channels.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan for retail and domestic sales, with significant export markets in the United States, Canada, Mexico, and other countries. It maintains overseas offices in the US (New Jersey), Canada, Hong Kong, and Shenzhen, China, supporting its international trade operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions mainly as a midstream trade intermediary and importer, sourcing products from manufacturers (upstream) and distributing to downstream retailers and end consumers. It also acts as an agent and distributor for imported fashion brands and medical devices, integrating supply chain logistics and sales channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include diversifying trade markets beyond the US, expanding brand portfolios in fashion and luxury goods, strengthening digital marketing and e-commerce capabilities, and investing in biotechnology and renewable energy sectors. The company focuses on innovation in product functionality, supply chain resilience, and sustainable business practices aligned with ESG principles.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales in export trade, domestic retail of fashion and luxury goods, and sales of medical devices and related healthcare products. Additional income derives from rental income, investment gains, and service fees related to its diversified business portfolio.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from other trading firms, domestic and international fashion retailers, and medical device distributors. It positions itself as a leading diversified trading and retail enterprise with strong brand agency capabilities, extensive overseas networks, and integrated investment in biotechnology and green energy to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, consolidated revenue reached approximately NT$8.87 billion, a 10.91% increase from the prior year. Net profit slightly decreased by 0.62% to NT$346 million. The company maintains a stable financial scale with total assets around NT$13 billion and equity of NT$6.78 billion, showing steady growth and solid profitability margins.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes comprehensive one-stop sourcing and distribution services, strong brand agency expertise, and diversified product offerings across trade, fashion, and biotech sectors. It differentiates through global market diversification, high-quality brand partnerships, innovative functional apparel, and integrated healthcare solutions, supported by robust logistics and digital marketing capabilities.
